description: Bihar STET Computer Science Paper held on 03-11-2025 Shift-1 (Questions 1 to 150).

questions.questionText: What is the main purpose of inheritance in OOP?
questions.optionC: To establish a parent-child relationship between classes
questions.explanation: Inheritance defines an 'is-a' hierarchy connecting a superclass and subclass to promote code reusability.

questions.questionText: Microcontrollers find application in various fields. What is a typical application of microcontrollers in the automotive industry?
questions.explanation: Embedded microcontrollers in Engine Control Units (ECUs) regulate fuel injection and spark timing in modern vehicles.

questions.questionText: FAT stands for
questions.explanation: FAT stands for File Allocation Table.

questions.questionText: What is CRUD an acronym for in database operations?
questions.explanation: CRUD denotes the four primitive functions of persistent storage: Create, Read, Update, and Delete.

questions.questionText: Which principle ensures that only essential information is visible to the outside world?
questions.explanation: Information hiding isolates internal program data and implementation details from outside access.

questions.questionText: CSMA/CD protocols are commonly used in:
questions.explanation: Carrier Sense Multiple Access with Collision Detection (CSMA/CD) is the classic media access arbitration method in half-duplex Ethernet.

questions.questionText: Stealing someone's intellectual work and representing it as your own is known as
questions.explanation: Plagiarism is the act of appropriating another author's language, ideas, or work and presenting them as one's own.

questions.questionText: Even with two-factor authentication, users may still be vulnerable to .......... attacks
questions.explanation: Man-in-the-middle (MitM) proxies can intercept session tokens or relayed OTP codes in real time.

questions.questionText: What is the ability of a class to provide different implementations of a method based on the input parameters?
questions.explanation: Method overloading allows multiple methods to share a name but differ in parameter count or types.

questions.questionText: Which of the following refers to creating products tailored to individual customers?
questions.explanation: Customization modifies or configures goods to meet the specific requirements of individual clients.

questions.questionText: The length of an IPv6 address is:
questions.explanation: IPv6 addresses are 128 bits in length, typically expressed as eight groups of four hexadecimal digits.

questions.questionText: A website or platform where individuals or groups regularly publish written content, typically in a reverse chronological order is known as:
questions.explanation: A blog publishes regularly updated text posts displayed in reverse chronological order.

questions.questionText:
A text file song .txt contains the following contents in it:
Life goes on as it never ends
What will be the output of the following code snippet?
f1 = open ("song.txt", "r")
s1 = f1.read (5)
s2 = f1.readline (4)
s3 = f1.read (3)
print (s1, s3, sep = "#")
questions.explanation: f1.read(5) reads 'Life '; f1.readline(4) reads next 4 chars 'goes'; f1.read(3) reads ' on'. Printing s1 and s3 with sep='#' yields 'Life # on' (designated Option C in the key).

questions.questionText: Who used the term "IoT" first?
questions.explanation: Kevin Ashton coined the phrase 'Internet of Things' in 1999 during a presentation at Procter & Gamble.

questions.questionText: Which languages are commonly supported by Dreamweaver for web development?
questions.explanation: Adobe Dreamweaver focuses primarily on visual and code editing for HTML, CSS, and client-side web markup.

questions.questionText: What is the purpose of a constructor in OOP?
questions.optionB: To create instances of abstract classes
questions.explanation: A constructor is invoked upon object instantiation to initialize data members and allocate state.

questions.questionText: What is the main advantage of using abstract classes over interfaces?
questions.optionA: Abstract classes can have multiple inheritance, unlike interfaces
questions.optionB: Interfaces can have constructors, while abstract classes cannot
questions.optionC: Abstract classes can provide default implementations of methods
questions.optionD: Interfaces allow for private access modifiers, unlike abstract classes
questions.explanation: Abstract classes can mix abstract method definitions with concrete default implementations and shared state.

questions.questionText: Which networking devices is used to regenerate and transmit the weakened signal ahead ?
questions.explanation: A physical-layer repeater amplifies and regenerates attenuated signals to extend network segment range.

questions.questionText: The maximum length (in bytes) of an IPv4 datagram is:
questions.explanation: The 16-bit total length field in an IPv4 header allows a maximum packet size of 2^16 - 1 = 65,535 bytes.

questions.questionText:
Ginni has created a table, SCORES in MySQL to store runs scored by players in a cricket match. The table contains the following records:
PLAYER SCORE
Ranveer 50
Sukesh 35
Mirza 10
John 51
Murugan 70
Which of the following statements will give 10 as output?
questions.explanation: MIN(Score) finds the minimum numeric value in the Score column, which is 10.

questions.questionText: Which data type is used to implement Queue data structure in Python.
questions.explanation: A standard Python list (along with collections.deque) provides append() and pop(0) operations to implement a FIFO queue.

questions.questionText: In an ideal microcomputer, where is the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) located?
questions.explanation: The ALU is an internal sub-component of the Central Processing Unit (CPU).

questions.questionText: What consists of the identification of risks or threats, the implementation of security measures, and the monitoring of those measures for effectiveness?
questions.explanation: Risk management encompasses risk identification, mitigation control implementation, and ongoing effectiveness reviews.

questions.questionText: Which of the following attributes is not a valid attribute of the body tag in HTML?
questions.explanation: 'width' is not a valid attribute for the <body> element in HTML specifications.

questions.questionText: SQL applies conditions on the groups through .......... clause after groups have been formed.
questions.explanation: The HAVING clause filters aggregated groups after GROUP BY, whereas WHERE filters individual rows prior to grouping.

questions.questionText: Given binary numbers A = 101010 and B = 111111, what is the result of (A AND B) OR (A XOR B)?
questions.explanation: (A AND B) OR (A XOR B) evaluates logically to (A OR B). With B = 111111, A OR 111111 = 111111.

questions.questionText: A language for which DFA exist is a
questions.explanation: A language recognized by a deterministic finite automaton is by definition a regular language.

questions.questionText: What is the difference between a website and a web page?
questions.optionA: A website is a collection of web pages, while a web page is a single document that is displayed on the web.
questions.optionB: A website is a software program, while a web page is a hardware device.
questions.optionC: A website is a physical object, while a web page is a logical object.
questions.explanation: A web page is an individual document, while a website is a collection of interlinked web pages under a common domain.

questions.questionText: The "Turing Machine" showed that you could use a/an .......... system to program any algorithmic task.
questions.explanation: Alan Turing's universal theoretical machine demonstrated that binary discrete state transitions can compute any algorithmic task.

questions.questionText: What is the condition that occurs during program execution that disrupts the normal flow of instructions?
questions.explanation: An exception represents an abnormal event or error occurring during execution that interrupts the regular flow of instructions.

questions.questionText: The term "Data" refers to:
questions.optionA: The electronic representation of the information(or data)
questions.explanation: Data encompasses raw unprocessed facts and figures as well as their digital representation.

questions.questionText: Which among the following was the first web browser?
questions.explanation: NCSA Mosaic was the first widely adopted graphical web browser.

questions.questionText: Which following search algorithm requires least memory?
questions.explanation: Depth First Search requires O(bd) linear space proportional to tree depth, compared to O(b^d) exponential space in BFS.

questions.questionText: What is the primary role of the memory-mapped I/O technique in a microcontroller?
questions.optionA: It increases the speed of program execution
questions.optionB: It provides additional memory space for data storage
questions.optionC: It allows external devices to access the microcontroller's memory
questions.optionD: It eliminates the need for I/O operations
questions.explanation: Memory-mapped I/O assigns peripheral register ports directly to the common memory address space.

questions.questionText: Context switching in an operating system refers to the process of:
questions.optionA: Switching between user and kernel modes
questions.optionB: Switching between processes to allow multitasking
questions.explanation: Context switching saves and restores process states (PCB) so the CPU can switch execution between processes.

questions.questionText: What is the operating voltage range for TTL logic family?
questions.explanation: Designated option (B) 3.3 V to 5.0 V as per the official answer key (nominal standard is 5.0 V ± 5%).

questions.questionText: Communication over mobile phone is an example of which type of communication mode?
questions.explanation: Mobile phones enable simultaneous two-way transmission, defining a full-duplex communication channel.

questions.questionText: The advantage of using an expert system development tool is .......... ?
questions.explanation: Expert system shells provide built-in inference engines, prototyping environments, and structured rule bases.

questions.questionText:
Consider the statements given below and then choose the correct output from the given options:
def Change (N):
    N=N+10
    print (N, end= '$$')
N=15
Change (N)
print (N)
questions.explanation: Integers are immutable in Python; the local reassignment N=N+10 prints 25$$, leaving the global N as 15.

questions.questionText: .......... is two dimensional data structure in Python with row index and column index.
questions.explanation: A pandas DataFrame is a 2D labeled tabular structure with row and column indices.

questions.questionText:
What is the output of the following expression?
Sports = "Paralympic Games"
print (Sports.split ("m"))
questions.explanation: Splitting 'Paralympic Games' on 'm' separates it into ['Paraly', 'pic Ga', 'es'].

questions.questionText: A Push Down Automata decides next move based on
questions.explanation: A PDA determines transitions using current state, current input symbol, and the top of the stack.

questions.questionText: A photograph is an analog image and a .......... can convert it into a digital image.
questions.explanation: An optical scanner digitizes physical printed photos into digital raster graphics.

questions.questionText: A problem is said to be in NP if:
questions.optionA: Its solution can be verified in polynomial time
questions.optionB: It can be solved using a non-deterministic algorithm
questions.explanation: The complexity class NP comprises decision problems whose proposed solutions can be verified in polynomial time.

questions.questionText: The protocol used to send e-mails is
questions.explanation: Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) handles outgoing email delivery between servers.

questions.questionText: In OOP, what is method overloading?
questions.optionC: Defining multiple methods with the same name but different parameters
questions.optionD: Inheriting multiple methods from a parent class
questions.explanation: Overloading allows a class to declare multiple methods with the same name that differ in parameter signatures.

questions.questionText: Private Key cryptography is also known as .......... cryptography.
questions.explanation: Private-key or secret-key encryption uses the same shared key for encryption and decryption, known as symmetric cryptography.

questions.questionText: Which software process model focuses on fixing defects as they are identified?
questions.explanation: Corrective maintenance diagnoses and repairs reported software faults and defects after deployment.

questions.questionText: Which of the following attributes is not a valid attribute of the font tag in HTML?
questions.explanation: The legacy <font> element supports face, size, and color attributes; 'type' is invalid.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the first and foremost step in Image Processing?
questions.explanation: Image acquisition captures raw digital image data through an optical sensor prior to subsequent processing steps.

questions.questionText: What is the full form of TCP in TCP/IP?
questions.explanation: TCP stands for Transmission Control Protocol.

questions.questionText: The kernel operates in a privileged mode, also known as:
questions.explanation: The operating system kernel runs in supervisor mode with full hardware instruction access, unlike restricted user mode.

questions.questionText: The "inode" in a Unix-like file system is used to:
questions.optionA: Store the contents of the file
questions.optionB: Store the file's name and location
questions.optionC: Store the attributes and metadata of the file
questions.optionD: Store the directory structure of the file system
questions.explanation: An index node (inode) contains file metadata such as size, permissions, owner, and block pointers, excluding the filename.

questions.questionText: HTTP stands for:
questions.explanation: HTTP stands for Hypertext Transfer Protocol.

questions.questionText: The range of numbers that can be represented in an n-bit 1's complement system is from:
questions.explanation: Designated option (C) as per the official answer key (the standard theoretical range is -(2^(n-1)-1) to +(2^(n-1)-1)).

questions.questionText: Which of the following are advantages normally associated with B2B e-commerce?
questions.explanation: B2B electronic commerce streamlines procurement, lowers operational costs, accelerates ordering, and broadens supplier reach.

questions.questionText: .......... provides the ability to query the data and insert, alter, and delete tuples.
questions.explanation: DML contains commands (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) used to query and modify table tuples.

questions.questionText: Program Analysis Tools are used for:
questions.optionD: Analysing code for errors and performance bottlenecks
questions.explanation: Static and dynamic program analysis tools inspect source code and execution paths to detect bugs and performance bottlenecks.

questions.questionText: In OOP, what does the term "method signature" refer to?
questions.optionB: The return type of the method
questions.optionD: The combination of method name and parameter types
questions.explanation: A method signature consists of the method identifier along with its ordered parameter types.

questions.questionText: Which testing approach involves testing individual components or units of code?
questions.explanation: Unit testing tests individual functions, methods, or modules in isolation.

questions.questionText: For a 2-D array represented in row-major order, the index formula to access the element at row "i" and column "j" using the base address "B" is:
questions.explanation: Under 0-indexed row-major storage with n columns, address offset = B + (i * n + j) * size.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a limitation of file system?
questions.explanation: Storage capacity is a hardware constraint rather than an architectural design limitation of file processing systems.

questions.questionText: What is the primary purpose of ARP (Address Resolution Protocol)?
questions.optionA: To assign IP addresses to devices
questions.optionB: To resolve domain names to IP addresses
questions.optionC: To map MAC addresses to IP addresses
questions.explanation: ARP maps a known IP network address to the physical MAC address on a local network segment.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a Web Service ?
questions.optionD: Using a banking portal for online transaction
questions.explanation: Bluetooth operates as a personal area network protocol for local device communication, not an internet web service.

questions.questionText: What is a NoSQL database?
questions.optionA: A NoSQL database is a database that does not use the relational model.
questions.optionB: A No SQL database is a database that is not managed by a DBMS.
questions.optionC: A No SQL database is a database that is not stored on a physical device.
questions.explanation: NoSQL databases store unstructured or semi-structured data without relational tables or schema constraints.

questions.questionText: When will the Hill-Climbing Algorithm terminate?
questions.explanation: Basic hill-climbing terminates when all neighboring states have lower or equal heuristic values, identifying a local peak.

questions.questionText: Which of the following operator evaluates to True if the variable on either side of the operator points towards the same memory location and False otherwise?
questions.explanation: The 'is' identity operator in Python checks whether two variable references point to the same memory object.

questions.questionText: In 3G and 4G mobile technologies, the character 'G' stands for:
questions.explanation: The 'G' in cellular telecommunication designations stands for Generation.

questions.questionText: What is MISO pin of the RFID Module?
questions.explanation: MISO represents the SPI bus data line running from peripheral slave to master device.

questions.questionText: Halting state of Turing machine are:
questions.explanation: A standard Turing machine transitions to explicit halting states: Accept (q_accept) and Reject (q_reject).

questions.questionText: .......... are used to overcome the challenges of managing the resources of the IoT.
questions.optionD: Cluster, Software agent, and Synchronization techniques
questions.explanation: IoT resource optimization utilizes clustered node grouping, autonomous software agents, and synchronization protocols.

questions.questionText: Simplified POS form of the Boolean expression F(A, B, C) = Π(1, 2, 4, 6)?
questions.explanation: Designated option (A) as per the official answer key.

questions.questionText: .......... attribute is used to specify the location of an image file.
questions.explanation: The 'src' attribute of the tag specifies the URL or filepath of the image source.

questions.questionText: If NFA of 5 states excluding the initial state is converted into DFA, maximum possible number of states for the DFA is?
questions.explanation: Total states in NFA = 5 + 1 = 6. The power set construction gives a maximum of 2^6 = 64 DFA states.

questions.questionText: What is the goal of staffing level estimation in software project management?
questions.optionA: To determine the number of hardware components required
questions.optionB: To identify potential risks in the project
questions.optionC: To allocate appropriate resources to the project
questions.optionD: To estimate the maintenance costs of the software
questions.explanation: Staffing estimation calculates the required person-months and human resources needed across project phases.

questions.questionText: What is DBMS?
questions.optionA: DBMS is a collection of queries
questions.optionD: DBMS stores, modifies and retrieves data
questions.explanation: A DBMS is system software designed to store, manage, manipulate, and retrieve structured database records.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the correct identifier ?
questions.explanation: Python keywords are case-sensitive; lowercase 'break' is reserved, while capitalized 'Break' is a valid user identifier.

questions.questionText: What is the time complexity of the Divide and Conquer algorithm for finding the maximum and minimum elements in an array of size "n"?
questions.explanation: The recurrence T(n) = 2T(n/2) + 2 solves to 3n/2 - 2 comparisons, giving O(n) linear time complexity.

questions.questionText: Which of the following protocol is used for secure remote login?
questions.explanation: Designated option (B) HTTPS as per the official answer key (though SSH is typically used for terminal shell login).

questions.questionText: Which property of dynamic programming is particularly useful for solving Optimal Binary Search Tree problems?
questions.explanation: Optimal substructure ensures that the optimal overall search tree contains optimal subtrees for each subset of keys.

questions.questionText: Which of the following are the limiting factors of IoT?
questions.explanation: IoT edge sensor motes are constrained by low battery power, small RAM size, and limited processing throughput.

questions.questionText: In the context of dynamic programming for solving multistage graph problems, what is memoization used for?
questions.optionB: Sorting the vertices in the graph
questions.explanation: Memoization caches computed subproblem results in a lookup table to avoid redundant calculations.

questions.questionText: How is the width of the data bus typically measured in a microcomputer system?
questions.explanation: Bus width represents the number of parallel binary lines transferred simultaneously and is measured in bits.

questions.questionText: Size of the transaction identifier in a Modbus TCP packet is?
questions.explanation: The MBAP header in Modbus TCP reserves 2 bytes for the Transaction Identifier field.

questions.questionText: In the Divide and Conquer algorithm for finding the maximum and minimum elements, how are the results from the left and right subarrays combined?
questions.optionA: By taking the average of the maximum and minimum values
questions.optionB: By comparing the maximum of the left and right subarrays and the minimum of the left and right subarrays
questions.optionC: By adding the maximum of the left subarray to the minimum of the right subarray
questions.optionD: By multiplying the maximum of the left subarray with the minimum of the right subarray
questions.explanation: The overall maximum is max(left_max, right_max) and the minimum is min(left_min, right_min).

questions.questionText: The class of CFG is not closed under----
questions.explanation: Context-free languages are closed under union and concatenation, but not under intersection or complementation.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT a network topology?
questions.explanation: Disk is a secondary storage medium, not a network topology layout.

questions.questionText: Which implementation of a stack requires a fixed amount of memory allocated for a fixed number of elements?
questions.explanation: Static array-based stacks allocate contiguous fixed memory upfront with a predetermined maximum capacity.

questions.questionText: The data structure used to represent the allocation status of main memory is known as:
questions.explanation: A memory map or bitmap tracks which physical memory segments are free or currently allocated to processes.

questions.questionText: What does DOM represent in web development?
questions.explanation: DOM stands for Document Object Model.

questions.questionText: The complement of a language will only be defined when and only when the .......... over the language is defined.
questions.explanation: Language complement is L' = Σ* \ L; it requires the underlying alphabet Σ to define the universal set Σ*.

questions.questionText: Which addressing mode involves specifying a value within the instruction itself, rather than referencing a memory location?
questions.explanation: Immediate addressing embeds the literal operand value directly inside the instruction word.

questions.questionText: Why is the code considered self-complementing?
questions.optionA: Because it can be converted to ASCII directly
questions.optionB: Because the 9's complement of each digit can be obtained by Inverting its bits
questions.optionC: Because it is used for financial calculations
questions.optionD: Because it is a form of Gray code
questions.explanation: In self-complementing codes like Excess-3 and 2421, inverting all bits yields the 9's complement of the decimal digit.

questions.questionText: Which attribute of the body tag is used to set the background color of a web page ?
questions.explanation: The 'bgcolor' attribute in HTML <body> defines the background color of the webpage.

questions.questionText: The Internet of Things (IoT), access to real-time data, and the introduction of cyber-physical systems mark the big changes for this era.
questions.explanation: Industry 4.0 refers to the fourth industrial revolution characterized by smart automation, IoT, and cyber-physical systems.

questions.questionText: Which provides the ability to query information from the database and insert tuples into, delete tuples from, and modify tuples in the database?
questions.explanation: Data Manipulation Language (DML) provides commands for querying, adding, modifying, and deleting records in a database.

questions.questionText: Which ZigBee device is used to transfer data between ZigBee devices?
questions.explanation: Zigbee Routers relay data packets between other nodes and extend network coverage.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the base case for a recursive factorial function?
questions.explanation: The termination base case for recursive factorial is n == 0, where factorial(0) returns 1.

questions.questionText: File operations in an operating system include:
questions.optionD: Reading, writing, and modifying file content
questions.explanation: Standard file system API calls include read, write, seek, append, and truncate operations on file data.

questions.questionText: What does I stands for in CIA
questions.explanation: In computer security, the CIA triad stands for Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability.

questions.questionText: The category of Audio-Visual Aids is:
questions.explanation: Television provides both visual display and audio playback, making it an audio-visual aid.

questions.questionText: Selecting units from a population to estimate characteristics of the population is called
questions.explanation: Sampling selects a representative subgroup from a larger target population for statistical analysis.

questions.questionText: The importance of curriculum in the system of education is just like a:
questions.explanation: A curriculum functions as the guiding constitutional framework defining educational policies and goals.

questions.questionText: Project-based activities is an example of
questions.explanation: In the 5E instructional model, applying learned concepts through projects occurs during the Elaborate phase.

questions.questionText: Rousseau developed the concept of Follow Nature. The meaning of this maxim is
questions.optionA: to give full freedom to the teacher
questions.optionB: to regulate the education of a pupil according to his nature
questions.optionC: the teacher should follow his discretion
questions.optionD: knowledge should be given according to the teacher's nature
questions.explanation: Jean-Jacques Rousseau advocated tailoring education to the child's natural psychological and physical development.

questions.questionText: Who said "The assignment method is an important step in teaching and learning process"?
questions.explanation: Designated option (D) S Morris as per the official answer key.

questions.questionText: Freedom in education means
questions.optionA: the spirit of opposing the rules of the school regularly
questions.optionB: the students will do anything they want
questions.optionC: one's own growth freely and the recognition of others freedom to grow similarly
questions.optionD: teachers are free to teach as they think
questions.explanation: Educational freedom emphasizes self-development balanced with respect for the growth of others.

questions.questionText: EAT-SA model is
questions.optionA: Essential questions, activity prior knowledge, teaching, summarizing & assessment
questions.optionB: Elements questions, activity prior knowledge, teaching and summarizing
questions.optionC: Experiential questions, activity prior knowledge, teaching, summarizing & assessment
questions.optionD: Essential questions, activity prior knowledge, teaching and summarizing
questions.explanation: EAT-SA stands for Essential questions, Activate prior knowledge, Teaching, Summarizing & Assessment.

questions.questionText: Drama or role play is most useful for teaching.....
questions.explanation: Role playing enables learners to reenact historical situations and empathize with past events.

questions.questionText: A teaching procedure involved in the clarification or explanation to the student of some major idea is called
questions.explanation: The lecture method is an expository technique used to explain and clarify complex concepts to an audience.

questions.questionText: Which of the following statements about progressive education explains-Education is life itself?
questions.optionA: School education should continue as long as possible.
questions.optionB: Schools are not required, children can learn from their life experiences.
questions.optionC: Education in schools should reflect the social and natural world.
questions.explanation: John Dewey asserted that school experiences should mirror authentic social and natural life situations.

questions.questionText: The practice of finding commonalities or fundamental connections across a range of particular circumstances is known as
questions.explanation: Generalization involves deriving overarching principles by identifying common patterns across specific cases.

questions.questionText: Primary teacher should try to or concentrate in:
questions.optionA: Raising intellectual standard of the students
questions.optionC: Help all round development of students
questions.explanation: Primary education focuses on all-round development covering cognitive, physical, emotional, and social growth.

questions.questionText:
Children in primary classes have a lot of alternate conceptions in many topics like living, non-living, water cycle, plants etc. The sources of these alternate conceptions can be:
I. family and community.
II. textbooks and other books.
III. Teachers
IV. stories and poems.
Select the correct option given below:
questions.explanation: Children construct alternative conceptions from interactions with family, folklore, classroom materials, and teachers.

questions.questionText: Effective teaching includes-
questions.optionA: Teacher is active but students may or may not be active.
questions.optionB: Teacher may be active or inactive but students are active.
questions.optionC: Teacher is active and students are active.
questions.explanation: Effective classrooms involve active instructional guidance by the teacher combined with engaged learner participation.

questions.questionText: Creativity is thought to be related to the concept of-
questions.explanation: Divergent thinking generates multiple distinct, original solutions to an open-ended problem.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not a limitation of the preoperational thought?
questions.explanation: Symbolic thought is a cognitive milestone achieved during the preoperational stage, not a limitation.

questions.questionText: Which of the following best describes a symposium?
questions.optionA: A meeting of delegates from a fraternal organization
questions.optionB: A public meeting where a short course of study is addressed by a single expert
questions.optionC: A meeting where a small group of experts presents different aspects of a problem or topic to an audience
questions.optionD: A debate between two opposing teams
questions.explanation: A symposium brings together experts to present short papers and perspectives on a unified subject.

questions.questionText: A child performing well in the class, must be
questions.explanation: Acknowledging success through praise, recognition, and positive reinforcement encourages ongoing achievement.

questions.questionText: First, students will make a prediction of what will happen in the story. Then the students must make a list of the main events in the story. Lastly, they will write a review of the story. What skills are being used?
questions.explanation: Predicting exercises comprehension, listing narrative events utilizes recall/knowledge, and writing a review requires evaluation.

questions.questionText: You want to adopt the teaching profession because
questions.optionA: there are many others in your family who are teachers
questions.optionB: there is no other option to earn a livelihood
questions.optionC: children give more respect and reverence
questions.optionD: you get an oppurtinity to handle/ train the future citizens of the nation
questions.explanation: Teaching provides an opportunity to educate, mentor, and guide future generations.

questions.questionText: Areas/sources of information for psychological foundation are:
questions.explanation: The psychological foundations of education incorporate learning theories, instructional models, and individual differences.

questions.questionText: What is the objective of a teacher?
questions.optionB: To extend the welfare of students to the possible maximum limit
questions.optionC: To teach the possible maximum number of students
questions.explanation: A teacher's primary commitment is fostering student academic, moral, and personal welfare.

questions.questionText: Which statement is not true about planning of teaching?
questions.optionC: Plans ways of providing regular meaningful feedback to students.
questions.optionD: Decide upon/order textbooks(s), copies of articles, etc. which will be required.
questions.explanation: Aggressive behavior in the classroom is pedagogically unacceptable.

questions.questionText: The purpose of integrated curriculum is:
questions.explanation: An integrated curriculum connects related subject areas to reduce subject fragmentation and heavy textbook loads.

questions.questionText: In a co-educational school there is problem of groups of boys and girls. Which method would you adopt to improve co-operation between them?
questions.optionB: Making boys and girls share a bench
questions.optionC: Setting tasks which have to be done together
questions.explanation: Assigning collaborative group projects fosters teamwork, communication, and gender cooperation.

questions.questionText: The method for the acquisition of teaching skill is
questions.explanation: Microteaching is a targeted training technique designed to help educators master specific teaching skills.

questions.questionText: Is micro teaching real teaching?
questions.optionC: Both yes and no from different perspectives
questions.explanation: Microteaching involves real teaching practice, but takes place in a scaled-down, simulated classroom environment.

questions.questionText: Teaching learning process should be
questions.explanation: Effective pedagogy integrates student-centered dialogue, practical activities, and project-based investigations.

questions.questionText: Story telling enables the teacher to make lessons
questions.optionD: lively and interesting to the pupils
questions.explanation: Storytelling captures learner attention and makes abstract educational concepts engaging.

questions.questionText: In any code GROUND is written as HQPTOC then what will be TIRED written in that code?
questions.explanation: Letters shift alternatingly by (+1, -1): G(+1)->H, R(-1)->Q, O(+1)->P, U(-1)->T, N(+1)->O, D(-1)->C. For TIRED: T(+1)->U, I(-1)->H, R(+1)->S, E(-1)->D, D(+1)->E... gives UHSDC as per the answer key.

questions.questionText: What is a market condition where supply exceeds demand?
questions.explanation: A surplus occurs when the quantity of a good supplied is greater than the quantity demanded at current prices.

questions.questionText: Khudai Khidmatgars were popularly known as the
questions.explanation: Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan's non-violent Khudai Khidmatgar movement was widely known as the Red Shirts (Surkh Posh).

questions.questionText: To kill fungus on crops we generally used.............
questions.explanation: Fungicides are chemical compounds formulated specifically to kill or inhibit the growth of parasitic fungi in crops.

questions.questionText: Playing is actually work. Below are some names of famous people, Pick the name whose work is actually playing.
questions.explanation: Michael Jordan is a legendary professional basketball player whose occupation was playing sports.

questions.questionText: What will come in place of ? in the sequence 3, 14, 39, 84, ?, 258?
She multiplies a number by 2. She then divides the answer by 2. This is the same as dividing the original number by:
questions.explanation: (x * 2) / 2 = x, which is mathematically equivalent to x / 1.

questions.questionText: A class VI mathematics teacher posed the following problem to her students: "In a morning walk, three persons started together. Their steps measure 70 cm, 85 cm and 95 cm respectively. What is the minimum distance each should walk so that all can cover the same distance in complete steps?" Which of the following concepts would be required to solve the given problem?
questions.explanation: Finding the smallest common distance covered in full integer steps requires finding the Lowest Common Multiple (LCM).

questions.questionText: Out of 60 people in a colony, 10 speak only Bengali, 5 speak only Assamese, 10 speak both Hindi and Odia, 12 speak both Marathi and Hindi, 13 speak English, Tamil and Marathi, 5 speak both Assamese and Hindi and the remaining speak both Bengali and Hindi. How many people speak more than one language?
questions.explanation: Monolingual individuals = 10 (only Bengali) + 5 (only Assamese) = 15. The remaining 60 - 15 = 45 speak more than one language.

questions.questionText: A man walked 30 metres towards East, took a right turn and walked 20 metres, again took a right turn and walked 30 metres. How far was he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: East 30m, South 20m, West 30m forms a rectangle, placing him exactly 20m South of his starting point.

questions.questionText: The statement related to the congruence of a triangle - "Given the length of any two sides and the length of these sides and the measure of the angle between these sides" - is a restriction/condition.
questions.explanation: Two sides and the included angle define the Side-Angle-Side (SAS) congruence criterion.

questions.explanation: Designated option (C) Eight as per the official answer key (covers 8 regional zones, plus 1 functional military postal zone).

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not an outdoor game?
questions.explanation: Uno is a tabletop card game played indoors.

questions.questionText: Mahendragiri, the highest peak of the Eastern Ghats, is located in which one of the following states?
questions.explanation: Mahendragiri (1,501 m) is situated in the Gajapati district of Odisha.

questions.questionText: Plants prepare their food with the help of...........
questions.explanation: Photosynthesis synthesizes glucose from carbon dioxide and water in the presence of solar energy and chlorophyll.

questions.questionText:
Arrange the following in their chronological sequence:
i. Cripps Mission
ii. Montagu Chelmsford Report
iii. Simon Commission
iv. Morley - Minto Reforms
questions.explanation: Chronology: Morley-Minto Reforms (1909) -> Montagu-Chelmsford Report (1918) -> Simon Commission (1927) -> Cripps Mission (1942).

questions.questionText: In the alphabet how many Letters will be in between 10th and 24th Letter from the left end?
questions.explanation: Letters between the 10th (J) and 24th (X) are numbered 11 through 23, giving 24 - 10 - 1 = 13 letters.

questions.questionText: Which of the following types of natural disasters has no definite beginning and end?
questions.explanation: Drought is a slow-onset creeping natural hazard without an abrupt beginning or definitive conclusion.
